entries.name: add
entries.description: Find, read, install and update skills and agents from a registry, in this project or for the user. Use when asked to add or connect a registry, install or read a skill or agent, see what a registry offers, check that installed skills are current, or keep them checked in CI.

entries.name: new
entries.description: Set up a registry of skills and agents for a person or a team, from nothing to installed. Use when asked to create, start or set up a registry, share skills with a team, or turn a folder of existing skills into a registry.

entries.name: publish
entries.description: Publish a skill or agent to a registry, or release a new version of one. Use when asked to publish, share, contribute or release a skill or agent, update one that is already in a registry, publish a project's skills from CI, or fix what registry validation reports.
